scope: Local socket-only PostgreSQL 17; no Production or network target
retentionNote: The rejected-fixture diagnoses and corrected 17/17 probe summary are retained here. The redundant one-sample task-created PROBE.json is excluded from Git; the final every-sample-validated benchmark is authoritative.

failures.cause: The scaled current side-game fixture had active Calcutta auction and result dependencies. The guard correctly denied PREPARE.
Reset match revisions collided with retained synthetic Google outbox rows at the same (match_id, match_revision). Direct first-child execution proved the unique-key conflict.
The original fixture set matches Live without a real ACCESS_ACTIVATE authority hash; all three applicable matches returned RESUME_AUTHORITY_BINDING_MISMATCH.

observations.method: Direct first-child public.mutate_production_match_control call inside BEGIN/ROLLBACK
observations.error: duplicate key value violates unique constraint google_outbox_events_match_id_match_revision_key

corrections: PREPARE selects a separate template cloned before scaled side-game history is seeded; the dependency guard is unchanged.
Open removes rollback-scoped synthetic outbox and audit history when resetting match revisions.
Resume performs the actual Open then Lock lifecycle before the timed Resume RPC.
